notes.title: Forest Ranger Services: Episode 2 Out Now!
notes.content:
A new chapter awaits!
Forest Ranger Services: Episode 2 is now available on Steam. 

While still a short experience, every step of Episode 2 was carefully crafted with a surprise waiting on every turn. Now with real voice actors and much more interactivity, mini-games and more!

Learn the FBI mans assignment and continue where you left off in Episode 1.



Follow the story of a wannabe reporter who got a job as a ranger to investigate the disappearances. Based on true events.



Thanks everyone for playing and special thanks to everyone who supported the project!

- GuardHouse
